27-unit cue-only comparison — October23,2026

Exploratory, historically exposed, label-conditioned pseudopopulation assay. Real fitting completed October23; this report was assembled November2,2026 from authenticated saved notebook outputs. It is not a new run, independent confirmation, simultaneous-population experiment or trial-specific path/H1 test.

Self-contained HTML · All seed-level metrics · Aggregate source accounting · Provenance · Frozen protocol · Execution and independent review

Download report.html and open it locally for offline reading with all figures embedded. Markdown and adjacent images are the Git-readable version. Linked CSV, JSON and protocol documents remain separate files.

Bottom line

  • Fresh construction, fitting and evaluation were completed. The three notebooks reconstructed selected cue inputs independently, fitted 6 CEBRA encoders, 10 PCAs, 78 logistic readouts and 12 LDAs, and recorded 180 fit-blocked saved-model/readout split checks. This report only extracts their saved aggregates and images.
  • No general CEBRA advantage. With full source pools, mean pair30 balanced accuracy was 17.1% for CEBRA versus 16.9% raw and 13.3% PCA; the CEBRA/raw difference is only 0.21 percentage points and varies by computational seed. For goal6, raw was 64.6%, PCA 59.6% and CEBRA 51.9%. These are endpoint assays, not path-beyond-endpoints evidence.
  • Training performance substantially exceeds development performance. Raw logistic training BA is 100% for all three targets, while development BA is 16.9–64.6%. Strong training fit is not reliable out-of-source performance. These gaps alone do not isolate their causes or establish an independent generalization estimate.
  • Reduced source pools usually hurt these descriptive scores. All 12 observed target/representation means have lower BA after reduction; the change ranges from −0.83 to −24.38 percentage points. This is one nested pool intervention at fixed synthetic-row count, not a biological sample-efficiency law.
  • The single permutation is a diagnostic, not a significance test. Its scores are near the uniform references. No null distribution, p-value or robust superiority claim follows from one shuffle on historically exposed sources.

What was measured and assembled?

The source measurements are cue-relative spike events/counts inherited from the reviewed six-file import route. The run freshly binned accepted events into ten 100-ms half-open bins over [0,1) seconds from cue onset. This was not a new read of acquisition files and did not use the later compact native-precision input route introduced October26.

Endpoint labels are derived/provisional: previous/current successful trial marker digits supply start/goal; unequal IDs 1–6 define 30 ordered pairs. A pair label is not an observed navigation path. Marker semantics and within-session simultaneity remain unverified.

Quantity This completed run
Selected units / session blocks 27 / 10
Real current-trial sources, training / exposed development 1,415 / 551
Full eligible historical pool before embargo/selection 195 units / 58 sessions; 12,288 train / 3,265 development
Training sources removed by global direct-contributor embargo 4,427; 7,861 survive globally
Training/development direct-contributor intersection 0
Synthetic rows per ordered pair, train / development 16 / 8
Synthetic rows per assembly, train / development 480 / 240
Cue bins / bin width 10 / 100 ms
Observed computational seeds 0, 1; one exposed split, not two folds
Permutation world seed50000; computational seed0 only

The embargo uses the union of current and predecessor IDs of all 3,265 original exposed-development examples, not merely the selected panel. A session survives only if every pair retains at least two training and one development source; all selected units in those sessions are retained. Selection used metadata/support, not neural values or model scores. This changes the cohort and estimand.

Each synthetic row draws one intact units×all-bins block per session, matching a known pair label, and concatenates ten blocks. It is not a simultaneous 27-unit trial. Missing off-block measurements stay masked, not zero. Sampling is with replacement: synthetic rows and adjacent bins are dependent derivatives of real sources. Same-session membership and contributor separation do not establish biological independence or unknown-label natural-trial prediction.

Accepted-event conservation was 27,598 binned + 518 omitted-tail = 28,116 events. Selected source×unit×bin shape was 1,966×27×10, with off-block masking; assembled train/development shapes were 480×27×10 and 240×27×10. These are spike counts, not firing rates. All selected sources cover the nominal first cue second.

Models and evaluation

All learned scaling, PCA, CEBRA and readouts were fitted on training assemblies only. Development assembly seed0 is fixed across observed seeds, budgets and models. Every budget reassembles training inputs and refits each learned stage.

Representation Whole-cue features and readout
Raw Training pooled-bin standardization; 27×10 = 270 features, unit-major flattening; separately scaled logistic per target
PCA Training pooled-bin standardization and full-SVD PCA8 per bin; 8×10 = 80 features, time-major flattening; separately scaled logistic
CEBRA Cue-only CEBRA-Time, offset1 model, hidden32, output8, temperature1, Adam lr0.0003, batch256, 1,000 updates; 80 whole-cue features; separately scaled logistic
LDA Raw supervised SVD-LDA classifier with training-only readout scaling; not an unsupervised or dimension-matched embedding baseline

Logistic uses C=0.01, max_iter=2000, lbfgs; observed convergence was 9–33 iterations. CEBRA sampling is row-uniform with adjacent native cue-bin positives; reference/positive/negative exposure is shown below. Decoder targets are pair30, start6 and goal6. All evaluation here concatenates the first cue second: no separate single-bin decoder grid was fitted.

Balanced accuracy (BA) is mean class recall. Accuracy equals BA for these balanced development assemblies. Macro-F1 is in [0,1]; log loss is mean negative log probability (natural-log units), lower is better. Uniform references are 1/30 (3.33%) and 1/6 (16.67%) for BA, and log(30)=3.401 / log(6)=1.792 for loss—not significance thresholds. No biological confidence intervals are estimated.

Label-permutation diagnostic

Joint pair labels were shuffled at source level within retained session×split (seed50000), before reassembly and refitting. Start/goal derive from the shuffled pair rather than separate inconsistent shuffles. Permuted reduced pools are nested under those effective labels. Its development assembly is fixed within that world, not identical to the observed assembly. Only computational seed0 was used here.

27-unit whole-cue assay, 480/240 label-conditioned rows per configuration. Bars are single-seed BA, not means/error bars; dotted lines=uniform references. Raw/PCA/CEBRA logistic readouts use the same settings as above; LDA was not run in this diagnostic. Different worlds have different assembled inputs. Source: saved C scalar outputs. One shuffle breaks alignment but is not an exchangeable biological null distribution, confidence interval, family-wise test or p-value.

The same cue-only 27-unit/ten-bin architecture and sampling settings apply throughout; there are no confidence intervals or decoder scores in these figures. Lower contrastive loss does not by itself establish useful endpoint information.

What differs from the 195-unit report?

The October7 endpoint report is a useful presentation template, not a matched control experiment.

Dimension Historical195-unit endpoint study This27-unit notebook run
Cohort 195 units / 58 sessions 27 units / 10 selected sessions after contributor embargo and support selection
Real sources, train/development 12,288 / 3,265 1,415 / 551; inherited exposed assignments
Observed seeds 0,1,2 0,1
Encoder comparison Cue-only vs joint cue/navigation Cue-only; full/reduced source pools
Evaluation windows Ten single bins plus whole cue Whole cue only
Permutations 20 diagnostic null worlds/families One alignment-breaking diagnostic world
Source-deletion sensitivity Included Not run
3D/temporal-transfer evidence Not supplied by that endpoint decoder comparison No new3D or frozen temporal-transfer analysis

Do not subtract the two studies' scores and attribute the difference to neuron count, embargo, joint training or software quality. Cohort, source support, construction/selection and experiment grids differ. Both use exposed, label-conditioned pseudopopulations; neither is pristine unknown-trial prediction. The October26–27 teaching/compact-source revisions were not biological B/C reruns; this report does not certify their current cells or compact-input numerical results.

Verification, access boundary and remaining limits

Historical execution: task b0497792d finished October23 at19:50:49SGT, exit0, 115.275s including the wrapper (receipt's internal notebook duration110.870s). 6 CEBRA /10 PCA /78 logistic /12 LDA;6,000 optimizer updates, excluding scaler fits. The actual cgroup peaked at1.09GiB under4GiB/no-swap/two-core limits, with no OOM; all three transient units ended. No further fit or worker is queued by this report. Independent reviewer cf4ffdf8 accepted the run and repeated180 fit-blocked readout/split replays; the original ledger records the exact scope and limitations.

This report's verification is narrower: it authenticates the saved receipt and all three executed notebook JSON files, extracts36 B +54 C scalar summaries, checks24 repeated raw/PCA summaries agree, and exports66 unique rows. It extracts all21 saved PNGs byte-for-byte, creates four scalar-summary charts, and embeds all25 in HTML. No notebook execution, model/pickle loading, original data access, neural reconstruction or new biological replay is performed. The original execution artifacts are unchanged. Numeric confusion matrices and finer support tables are not re-exported; their saved figures remain the visual evidence.

Biological interpretation remains bounded by inherited source selection and exposure, serial/session dependence, provisional endpoint labels, and label-conditioned assembly. Direct current/predecessor contributor separation does not remove all confounds or prove simultaneous recording, mechanism, intention, formal observability, path information beyond endpoints, or superiority on future recordings. Synthetic row counts and computational seeds are not independent biological replications.
